# Regional Totals Summary Report

## Overview
This report summarizes transaction amounts across three regions based on 24 complete records (R001-R024).

## Results

| Region | Record Count | Total Amount (cents) | Total Amount ($) |
|--------|--------------|----------------------|------------------|
| North  | 8            | 232,878              | $2,328.78        |
| South  | 8            | 492,527              | $4,925.27        |
| West   | 8            | 457,793              | $4,577.93        |
| **Total** | **24**   | **1,183,198**        | **$11,831.98**   |

## Key Findings
- The South region has the highest total transaction amount at $4,925.27
- The North region has the lowest total transaction amount at $2,328.78
- Transaction amounts are distributed evenly across all three regions (8 records each)
- All 24 records have been successfully processed and included in the summary

## Processing Notes
All records from R001 through R024 have been validated and included in this report. No missing or duplicate records were detected.
